payload.reason: The evidence describes the ParityBOT system, which detects and classifies hateful tweets aimed at women in politics using a real-time Twitter listener and analysis methods.

claims.text: ParityBOT classifies hateful tweets directed at women in politics using a real-time Twitter listener that analyzes tweets mentioning specific candidates.
The classification system of ParityBOT was validated on public online harassment datasets, ensuring its effectiveness in identifying hateful content.
ParityBOT aims to improve public discourse by responding to hateful tweets with supportive messages, thereby countering online abuse.
